page.overview:
Who is "Harpoon" Harrison?

https://jurassicpark.fandom.com/wiki/Jurassic_Park_III_(Hasbro)|family=Unknown|born=Unknown|died=Unknown}} "Harpoon" Harrison is a character that first appears in the Jurassic Park Series 2 toyline. He is one of the Dino Trackers. His profession is the rescue and retrieval of exotic animals.

At high school he was a champion of wrestling and later of the All-American football team. He made his living at an alligator farm in Florida, as well as capturing escaped animals worldwide before becoming a Dino Tracker. At the farm he worked together with Dr. Snare, who later formed the Evil Raiders.

The Brachiosaurus Harrison works with is a repaint of the one featured in the Tim Murphy (Which is shown in the gallery)

A variant of Harrison with a different skin tone is released for The Lost World Series 1.
